title: Baseball
text:
Baseball Through the Data
This site uses the Lahman database to explore Major League Baseball history. Raw home-run totals can make shortened seasons look like dramatic slumps; comparing home runs per team-game gives a fairer view of how the rate changed.
Visit Home runs in the navbar to explore the season trend and compare shortened seasons. Sluggers ranks career home-run leaders and takes a closer look at Barry Bonds’ season-by-season totals.
